generate_mujoco_cython_wrappers: run gen_wrappers.py to generate Cython wrapper code from MuJoCo C header files
parse_c_structs_to_dict: use get_struct_dict to parse a pycparser AST struct node into a categorized field dictionary
extract_c_array_shapes: use get_array_shapes to parse shape hints from MuJoCo header comment annotations
extract_c_enum_constants: use get_const_from_enum to parse preprocessed C source and extract enum constant values
generate_cython_function_wrappers: use get_funcs to parse MuJoCo C function signatures and generate Cython wrapper stubs
